hooks.logic:
Let currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo be the phase matching the current form of the enemy under the phases list.
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for the enemy under the phases list.
If condition flag "ability_done" is up this frame and util passes a fraction roll of the numeric entry list at currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo's 'attackRate' in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then the enemy uses (a smart-weighted move of the enemy) immediately with options {skipStepCnt: true} and stop.
Otherwise, if the current form of the enemy is not paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs, then
  The enemy changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.
  The enemy cancels its cast and stop.
Otherwise
  If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
  Stop.
